In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
Story 1: NSE files for India's biggest ever IPO
India's largest stock exchange has filed its DRHP with SEBI. We break down how NSE makes money, why Nifty50 weekly options power nearly 60% of its revenue, how SEBI's 2024 F&O circular hit its bottom line, and what NSE Clearing Limited does behind every trade. If you have ever traded on NSE and wondered who actually profits when you do, this story answers that.
